questions.stem: An endothermic reaction $$ A \rightarrow B $$ has an activation energy $$ 15 \text{ kcal/mole} $$ and the energy of reaction is $$ 5 \text{ kcal/mole} $$. The activation energy of the reaction $$ B \rightarrow A $$ is;

For a reaction, $$ \Delta H = E_{a(\text{forward})} - E_{a(\text{backward})} $$.

$$ 5 = 15 - E_{a(\text{backward})} $$
$$ E_{a(\text{backward})} = 15 - 5 = 10 \text{ kcal/mol} $$

**Result:** 10 kcal/mole
